executions.claim: If fewer than 5 bytes remain, the remaining bytes are copied into hdr_store, bytes_in_header is set to remain, and the loop exits without further parsing.

When bytes_in_header is nonzero, 8 - bytes_in_header bytes are copied from start into hdr_store and a start code is searched in the first 8 bytes; if no start code is found or it lies at/after bytes_in_header, the stored bytes are dispatched and bytes_in_header is reset to 0.
When a valid start code is found in the stored header, hdr_offset is computed as 4 - bytes_in_header + current, bytes_from_store is set to bytes_in_header, and bytes_in_header is reset to 0.
If no start code is found in the packet and no frame has started, the loop breaks and the packet is dropped.

If no start code is found but a frame has started, size is set to remain; if any of the last three bytes is zero, the last three bytes are withheld, size is reduced by 3, and bytes_in_header is set to 3.
If vosh_start is nonnegative and current is nonzero, start is advanced by current and remain is reduced by current, then current is set to 0.
If there is no output pid and current is nonzero, start is advanced by current and remain is reduced by current, then current is set to 0.
When current is positive and bytes_from_store is zero, current bytes are copied from start, start is advanced by current, remain is reduced by current, and current is set to 0.
For an M4V_VOS_START_CODE, start is advanced by 5 and remain is reduced by 5.
For an M4V_VOL_START_CODE with successful parsing, vosh_end is computed from start, data, obj_size, and vosh_start; start is advanced by obj_size and remain is reduced by obj_size.
For default/other start codes, if vosh_start is nonnegative, start is advanced by 4 and remain is reduced by 4.
If there is no output pid, start is advanced by 4 and remain is reduced by 4, then the loop continues.
If the filter is not playing, resume_from is set to the offset of start from data and the function returns GF_OK.
If fewer than 5 bytes remain after the preceding checks, the loop continues without parsing a frame.
